item.title: Fewer Crimes, Safer Streets: Hungarian Police Deliver Excellent 2025 Results
item.description: In 2025, Hungary recorded approximately 179,000 criminal offenses — a notable decrease compared to the previous year. The decline was visible across most categories, including street crimes and serious offenses, returning figures closer to pre-2024 levels. Based on the National Police Headquarters’ data (ORFK), registered crimes dropped by around 12% overall. item.title: Serbia-Hungary Pipeline Well Ahead of Schedule
item.description: The government has designated the construction of the Hungarian-Serbian oil pipeline and its associated infrastructure as a priority investment project, thereby expediting the approval and construction processes. The clear aim of this measure is to strengthen energy security and reduce the region’s dependence, Világgazdaság reports.
